values: 召唤风暴持续击飞所有敌人，并持续激发“风雷晶瞳”对敌人造成真实伤害。
Marene summons a storm that continuously knocks all enemies into the air. At the same time, she activates Tempest Eye to deal true damage to enemies.
卓琳飞入高空，召唤持续4秒的风暴立即对所有敌人造成其30% + 3%生命值的伤害（不超过自身500% + 50%攻击力），风暴期间持续击飞所有敌人并使其远程防御降低20点，并且每秒激发2次“风雷晶瞳”召唤落雷攻击所有敌人造成110% + 15% ATK真实伤害，激发间隔受自身急速属性影响且每秒最多激发8次。卓琳技能期间处于无敌状态。

Marene soars into the air and summons a storm that lasts for 4s. It immediately deals damage to all enemies equal to 30% + 3% of their HP, up to 500% + 50% of her ATK. While the storm is active, Marene continuously knocks all enemies into the air, reducing their Ranged DEF by 20. Additionally, Marene activates Tempest Eye 2 times per second, calling down lightning strikes that deal 110% + 15% ATK true damage to all enemies. The activation frequency scales with her Haste, up to a maximum of 8 activations per second. Marene remains invincible when casting this skill.
该技能激发“风雷晶瞳”造成的伤害提高至120% + 15% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by Tempest Eye through this skill to 120% + 15% ATK.
该技能激发“风雷晶瞳”造成的伤害提高至130% + 15% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by Tempest Eye through this skill to 130% + 15% ATK.
该技能激发“风雷晶瞳”造成的伤害提高至140% + 15% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by Tempest Eye through this skill to 140% + 15% ATK.
该技能激发“风雷晶瞳”造成的伤害提高至150% + 15% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by Tempest Eye through this skill to 150% + 15% ATK.
卓琳受到的急速属性增益提高。主动释放时在一段时间内持续激发“风雷晶瞳”对敌人造成伤害。
Marene receives stronger Haste buffs. When this skill is used actively, Marene repeatedly activates Tempest Eye for a duration to deal damage to enemies.

被动地，卓琳受到来自友军施加的急速属性增益效果提高100%且不会因增益消失而失去急速，但相同增益效果提供的急速属性增益不会叠加。
主动释放时，卓琳控制“风雷晶瞳”持续2秒，每秒激发2次“风雷晶瞳”在敌人所在位置召唤小型气流（按照从前至后的顺序优先选择不同敌人），对目标周围1格范围内的敌人造成110% + 15% ATK伤害，激发间隔受自身急速属性影响且每秒最多激发8次。

Passive. Marene amplifies the Haste buffs her allies grant her by 100% and retains the Haste gained even after those buffs expire. Haste bonuses from the same buff do not stack.
Active. Marene channels her Tempest Eye for 2s, activating it 2 times per second. Each activation generates a small gust of wind at an enemy's position, dealing 110% + 15% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile of the target. Targets are selected from front to back, prioritizing different enemies. The activation frequency scales with her Haste, up to a maximum of 8 activations per second.
该技能激发“风雷晶瞳”造成的伤害提高至115% + 15% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by Tempest Eye through this skill to 115% + 15% ATK.
该技能激发“风雷晶瞳”造成的伤害提高至120% + 15% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by Tempest Eye through this skill to 120% + 15% ATK.
该技能激发“风雷晶瞳”造成的伤害提高至125% + 15% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by Tempest Eye through this skill to 125% + 15% ATK.
向距离最近和最远的敌人分别发射一团风刃，持续造成范围伤害。
Marene launches a cluster of wind blades at each of the nearest and farthest enemies, dealing continuous AoE damage.
凝聚两团风刃，分别发射向距离自身最近和最远的各一名敌人，风刃会围绕目标切割2秒，每0.5秒对目标及其周围2格范围内的敌人造成110% + 15% ATK伤害。

Marene conjures 2 clusters of wind blades and launches them at the nearest and farthest enemies, respectively. The blades circle and slash at their targets for 2s, dealing 110% + 15% ATK damage to the targets and enemies within 2 tiles of them every 0.5s.
Increases the damage dealt to 115% + 15% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 120% + 15% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 125% + 15% ATK.
战斗中提升自身攻击力，每次激发“风雷晶瞳”后额外提高。
Marene increases her ATK during battle, with a further increase each time Tempest Eye activates.
自身提高6%攻击力，每次激发“风雷晶瞳”后额外提高0.6%，至多提高30次。
Marene increases her ATK by 6%. Each activation of Tempest Eye increases her ATK by an extra 0.6%, stacking up to 30 times.
自身提高8%攻击力，每次激发“风雷晶瞳”后额外提高0.8%，至多提高30次。
Marene increases her ATK by 8%. Each activation of Tempest Eye increases her ATK by an extra 0.8%, stacking up to 30 times.
自身提高10%攻击力，每次激发“风雷晶瞳”后额外提高1%，至多提高30次。
Marene increases her ATK by 10%. Each activation of Tempest Eye increases her ATK by an extra 1%, stacking up to 30 times.
拥有一定急速属性增益后进入稳定状态并且受到伤害降低，激发一定次数的“风雷晶瞳”后召唤巨型风暴持续对敌人造成伤害，并且周期性击飞敌人。

Marene becomes steadfast and takes less damage once her Haste bonus reaches a certain amount. After Tempest Eye activates enough times, she summons a massive thunderstorm that continuously deals damage to enemies and periodically knocks them into the air.
在战斗中拥有来自友军提供的至少60点急速增益时，卓琳进入“风涌”状态：处于稳定且受到伤害降低45%，造成伤害时无视敌人45%远程防御属性。累计激发30次“风雷晶瞳”后，卓琳制造混合雷电的巨型风暴永久覆盖战场，每秒对所有敌人造成110% ATK真实伤害，每5秒产生强气流击飞所有敌人并摧毁所有障碍物。

When the Haste bonus Marene gains from allies reaches 60, she enters Windborne state, becoming steadfast and taking 45% less damage and ignoring 45% of enemies' Ranged DEF when dealing damage. Once her Tempest Eye has activated 30 times, she unleashes a massive thunderstorm that permanently covers the battlefield. It deals 110% ATK true damage to all enemies every second and unleashes powerful gusts every 5s that knock all enemies into the air and destroy all obstacles.
每秒伤害量提高至130% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt per second to 130% ATK.
每秒伤害量提高至150% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt per second to 150% ATK.
巨型风暴中，不处于稳定或霸体状态的敌人在当前生命值低于卓琳1000%攻击力且生命值比例低于35%时，会被吹出战场，以此法吹出战场的敌人无法回到战场，视作被击败。

The thunderstorm can sweep enemies off the battlefield. This effect only applies to enemies who are neither steadfast nor unaffected, with remaining HP below 1000% of Marene's ATK and an HP ratio below 35%. Enemies swept away this way cannot return to the battlefield and are considered defeated.
“疾风汹涌”和“风刃双环”额外造成真实伤害和短暂眩晕。
Gathering Gale and Twin Cyclone deal extra true damage and briefly stun their targets.
技能“疾风汹涌”召唤的小型气流以及“风刃双环”凝聚的气旋刃均会附带雷电，每次造成伤害时额外附带30% ATK真实伤害并使目标眩晕0.25秒，同时使目标永久降低4点受愈，该效果至多叠加15层。

The small gusts summoned by Gathering Gale and the wind blades created by Twin Cyclone are infused with lightning. Each hit deals an extra 30% ATK true damage and stuns the target for 0.25s, and permanently reduces the target's Vitality by 4, stacking up to 15 times.
